grammar_concept.title: Past Simple: Regular and Irregular Verbs
grammar_concept.rule: Use the Past Simple for actions that finished in the past. Regular verbs add -ed (work → worked). Irregular verbs change form completely (go → went) and must be memorised.
grammar_concept.simple_explanation: We use this tense for something that happened and finished — yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago.
grammar_concept.example: I worked late yesterday. She went to the cinema last night.
grammar_concept.example_translation: Eu trabalhei até tarde ontem. Ela foi ao cinema ontem à noite.
grammar_concept.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português tendem a usar o verbo na forma base com uma palavra de tempo passado, sem mudar o verbo: dizem "I go to the beach yesterday" em vez de "I went to the beach yesterday" — em português o tempo já está marcado no verbo, mas em inglês é preciso mudar mesmo a palavra.
grammar_concept.correction: Sempre mude o verbo para a forma de passado: verbos regulares levam -ed (watch → watched), verbos irregulares mudam de forma (go → went, have → had, see → saw) — não basta adicionar "yesterday" ao verbo no presente.
grammar_concept.real_world_example: A dizer a um colega: "I finished the report yesterday and sent it to the client."

vocabulary.definition_en: to leave home to do something social
example_sentences: We went out for dinner last night.
I stayed home and rested yesterday.

vocabulary.definition_en: to watch a film, usually at home or at the cinema
example_sentences: They watched a movie together last night.

exercises.prompt: Complete the sentence: Yesterday, I ___ (go) to the cinema.
exercises.explanation: "Go" é irregular no passado — a forma correta é "went", não "goed".
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Falantes de português tendem a manter o verbo na forma base ("go") só porque já disseram "yesterday".

correct_answer: She watched a movie last night.
distractors: She watch a movie last night.
She watching a movie last night.
She is watch a movie last night.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Esquecer o -ed em verbos regulares é o erro mais comum nesta posição.

correct_answer: to leave home to do something social
exercises.explanation: "Go out" refere-se especificamente a sair de casa para uma atividade social.

exercises.prompt: Listen to the audio. What did Tom do last night?
exercises.explanation: No áudio, ouve-se: "Last night, Tom stayed home and watched a movie with his sister."
exercises.transcript: Last night, Tom stayed home and watched a movie with his sister.

exercises.prompt: Read the text: "Yesterday was a busy day for Maria. She woke up early, went to work, and in the evening she cooked dinner for her family." What did Maria do in the evening?
exercises.explanation: O texto indica diretamente que, à noite, ela "cooked dinner for her family".

exercises.prompt: Translate to English: "Ontem à noite, eu fiquei em casa e vi um filme."
correct_answer: Last night, I stayed home and watched a movie.
exercises.explanation: Atenção às duas formas de passado: "stayed" (regular) e "watched" (regular) — nenhum dos dois é irregular aqui, mas ambos precisam do -ed.
exercises.common_mistake_pt: Esquecer o -ed em "stayed" e/ou "watched" é o erro mais comum nesta frase.

steps.content: Practise the -ed ending sound: worked /wɜːrkt/, watched /wɒtʃt/, stayed /steɪd/ — three different sounds (/t/, /t/, /d/) depending on the final sound of the base verb.

steps.prompt: Describe what you did yesterday in 3-4 sentences using the Past Simple.
Write 5 sentences about your last weekend using the Past Simple.
